assets.prompt: The Bone Scepter, a stray: a Bone skull with dark Void eye sockets (the face layer lights them) and a toothed jaw on a Wood stick with a Void ring and a Void ferrule. A 32x32 body with its ferrule at the bottom (row 28), 1px dark outline, light from the top-left; the face (eyes and brows) is a separate layer. Only non-overlapping rect elements, whole-number coordinates, palette colours from docs/STYLE.md; no player colours.
